head_commit.message:
Add verbose output mode feature

Implements configurable output verbosity levels to give users control over command output display.

Features:
- Four verbosity levels: Summary, Auto, Verbose, Full
- Configurable via config.toml, CLI flags, and runtime commands
- Smart auto mode with error detection and important command recognition
- Three truncation strategies: Head, Tail, Middle
- Output buffer for retrieving previous command outputs
- Runtime commands: /verbose and /expand

Configuration:
- Added output section to config.toml
- CLI flags: --verbose and --max-output-lines
- Runtime toggle via slash commands

Implementation:
- OutputFormatter handles formatting logic
- OutputConfig stores configuration
- ExecOutputHandler integrates with execution system
- Full test coverage included

Resolves #2655
